question: National Infrastructure Readiness Index (NIRI) was launched in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mon Apr 01 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **National Infrastructure Readiness Index (NIRI)** was launched on **Mon Apr 01 2024**. This initiative is aimed at assessing the readiness of infrastructure across various sectors.

• The **NIRI** evaluates critical infrastructure such as transportation systems, energy grids, water supply systems, and urban planning frameworks.

• The index provides a comprehensive analysis of the **current state of infrastructure development** and highlights areas needing improvement for sustainable growth.

• The launch date aligns with the government's **strategic planning** for infrastructure development in the financial year 2024-2025.

• **NIRI** is a tool intended to guide policymakers, investors, and stakeholders in making informed decisions regarding infrastructure investment and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Purpose of NIRI:** 

• **National Infrastructure Readiness Index** aims to assess the preparedness of infrastructure to support economic growth and social development.

• The index is designed to monitor progress in infrastructure development and identify gaps in planning, execution, and maintenance.

• **Key Features:** 

• The index focuses on **sustainability, efficiency, and resilience** of infrastructure systems.

• It includes metrics for evaluating urban infrastructure, rural connectivity, and environmental impact.

• The data collected is analyzed and shared in reports to assist in strategic planning and policymaking.

• **Applications of NIRI:** 

• **Policy Formation:** Provides insights for government bodies to formulate effective infrastructure policies.

• **Investment Guidance:** Helps investors identify viable projects and areas with high growth potential.

• **Performance Benchmarking:** Enables comparison of infrastructure readiness across regions and sectors.

• **Global Relevance:** 

• India’s focus on infrastructure readiness aligns with global efforts such as the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).**

• The index supports India's commitment to **economic progress**, improving quality of life, and addressing climate change challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Launch Date:** **April 1, 2024**, marks the beginning of the financial year, making it an opportune time to introduce initiatives for economic planning.

• **Strategic Importance:** The index serves as a foundational step to evaluate and enhance India's infrastructure capabilities.

• **Sectoral Impact:** The infrastructure readiness index is expected to improve sectors like transportation, energy, water supply, and urban planning.

• **Government Focus:** The launch aligns with India’s increasing emphasis on infrastructure development, which is a critical driver for economic growth and job creation.
